name: Cheddar-Crusted Chicken
description: Suggested sides: Roasted green beans as well as sweet potatoes mashed with sour cream and butter

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 2 Chicken Breasts; 2 Tbsp Mayonnaise; 1/4 cup Panko Breadcrumbs; 1/4 cup Cheddar Cheese, shredded; 1 Tbsp Smoked Paprika-Garlic Blend. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Cheddar Cheese: shredded. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Combine panko, cheese, and smoked paprika-garlic blend in a shallow dish.
Pat chicken dry with paper towel.
Carefully slice into the centre of each chicken breast lengthwise and parallel to the cutting board - leaving 1/2 inch intact on the other end.
Open up chicken like a book, and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Coat one side of each chicken breast with mayo.
Firmly press mayo-coated side into panko mixture to adhere, one at a time.
Transfer chicken to a parchment-lined baking sheet, coated-side up.
Bake chicken on the middle oven rack until cooked through (18-20 mins).

Before serving, insert a food thermometer into the thickest piece of chicken or turkey, away from bone: it must reach 165°F (74°C). If using already-cooked poultry, reheat it to 165°F (74°C). Continue cooking and recheck if needed; wash hands and utensils after handling raw poultry and do not rinse it.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. Combine panko, cheese, and smoked paprika-garlic blend in a shallow dish. Preheat oven to 425F.
2. Pat chicken dry with paper towel. Carefully slice into the centre of each chicken breast lengthwise and parallel to the cutting board - leaving 1/2 inch intact on the other end. Open up chicken like a book, and season both sides with salt and pepper.
3. Coat one side of each chicken breast with mayo. Firmly press mayo-coated side into panko mixture to adhere, one at a time.
4. Transfer chicken to a parchment-lined baking sheet, coated-side up. Bake chicken on the middle oven rack until cooked through (18-20 mins).
